excerpt_i18n.en: Lei Feng Network AI Tech Review exclusively learned that MiniMax's Senior Research Director, Zhong Yiran, has left the company, with her next destination not yet publicly disclosed. Public records show Dr. Zhong Yiran earned her Ph.D. from the Australian National University under the supervision of Professor Li Hongdong and Academician Richard Hartley. She has published over 40 research papers in internationally recognized journals and top-tier academic conferences, including TPAMI, IJCV, IEEE TIP, CVPR, NeurIPS, ECCV, ICCV, ICLR, and EMNLP, and holds multiple U.S. patents. She also received the 2023 ICCV Workshop Best Paper Award and the 2014 ICIP Best Student Paper Award. After completing her Ph.D., Zhong Yiran joined SenseTime in 2021 as a Senior Manager, focusing on research in large language models, multi-turn dialogue, and multimodal fusion. In 2022, she joined the Shanghai AI Laboratory as a Young Scientist, serving as the PI of the New Architecture Exploration Group and the head of OpenNLPLab, concentrating on efficient large language models and audio-visual-language multimodal fusion. By the end of 2023, at MiniMax, she proposed concepts for efficient architectures in large models and collaborated with the R&D team to advance linear attention mechanisms in large-scale language models.

AI is no longer a standalone algorithm but has become the decision-making engine of IoT systems. The new goal for AIoT computing networks and agent systems is to imbue the physical world with cognitive and autonomous capabilities akin to a nervous system. At the 2025 World Laureates Forum, Kevin Yin, founder and CEO of Terminus Group, was invited to share insights with top global tech leaders on advancing the large-scale implementation of advanced AI technologies and launched a series of AIoT products, including "Heterogeneous Computing Super Nodes" and "New Intelligent Agents." 

Redefining AIoT: From Hybrid Intelligence Computing to Super Intelligent Agents

At the forum, Kevin Yin officially unveiled Terminus Group's upgraded corporate strategy, focusing on AIoT technology with computing power (AIoT Infra) and intelligent agents (AIoT Agent) as the two core business areas to accelerate the large-scale deployment of AI. Computing power serves as the foundational support, providing high-performance computational resources for top-level intelligent agents, while the agents enhance the utilization and energy efficiency of cluster resources through their "perception-decision-execution" closed loop, fostering iterative improvements in computing infrastructure and creating a positive feedback cycle.

Kevin Yin also detailed the product architecture and model of Terminus Group's computing power (AIoT Infra) business, which utilizes a cluster of heterogeneous chip hardware and two software platforms—the spatial intelligence base TacOS and the hybrid inference engine HICE—to build a hybrid intelligence computing cloud. This setup offers standardized, stable inference services and computing power leasing operations to the industry, establishing a TaaS (Token as a Service) business model.

En el Foro Mundial de Científicos Líderes 2025, Ai Yu, fundador y CEO de Telstra, fue invitado a compartir logros exploratorios en la implementación a gran escala de tecnologías avanzadas de IA junto con líderes globales de la tecnología, y presentó productos de la serie AIoT como "nodos superiores de computación heterogénea" y "nuevos agentes inteligentes". Redefiniendo AIoT: de la computación inteligente híbrida al superagente inteligente. Durante el foro, Ai Yu lanzó oficialmente la estrategia empresarial actualizada de Telstra, centrada en AIoT.

title_i18n.en: Built to benefit everyone
title_i18n.zh: 为惠及众人而建
title_i18n.es: Creado para beneficiar a todos

excerpt_i18n.en: OpenAI’s recapitalization strengthens mission-focused governance, expanding resources to ensure AI benefits everyone while advancing innovation responsibly.
excerpt_i18n.zh: OpenAI的资本重组强化了以使命为核心的治理，扩大资源以确保人工智能惠及所有人，同时负责任地推进创新。
excerpt_i18n.es: La recapitalización de OpenAI refuerza la gobernanza centrada en la misión, ampliando los recursos para garantizar que la inteligencia artificial beneficie a todos mientras impulsa la innovación de manera responsable.

items.title: The next chapter of the Microsoft–OpenAI partnership
items.raw_excerpt: Microsoft and OpenAI sign a new agreement that strengthens its long-term partnership, expands innovation, and ensures responsible AI progress.

title_i18n.en: The next chapter of the Microsoft–OpenAI partnership
title_i18n.zh: 微软与OpenAI合作的新篇章
title_i18n.es: El próximo capítulo de la asociación entre Microsoft y OpenAI

excerpt_i18n.en: Microsoft and OpenAI sign a new agreement that strengthens its long-term partnership, expands innovation, and ensures responsible AI progress.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 微软与OpenAI签署新协议，强化长期合作伙伴关系，推动创新并确保人工智能负责任地发展。
excerpt_i18n.es: Microsoft y OpenAI firman un nuevo acuerdo que refuerza su asociación a largo plazo, amplía la innovación y garantiza un progreso responsable en la inteligencia artificial.
